name: Rectangular Dining Table
description: Six-seat rectangular dining table: 1600 x 900 mm top at 750 mm height, four 60 mm square legs, perimeter aprons and rounded top corners.

steps.instruction: Create the tabletop: a 1600 x 900 mm slab, 30 mm thick, centered in X and Y, with its top face at Z=750 (slab from Z=720 to Z=750).

transcript.user_prompt: Start a dining table. Create the tabletop first: a rectangular slab 1600 mm long (X) by 900 mm wide (Y) by 30 mm thick, centered in X and Y, with its top face at Z=750 so the slab spans Z=720 to Z=750.
transcript.assistant_message: I've created the 1600 x 900 mm tabletop, 30 mm thick, floating with its top surface at the standard 750 mm dining height.

steps.instruction: Add four 60 x 60 mm square legs from Z=0 to Z=720, centered at X=+/-690 and Y=+/-340 (outer faces inset 80 mm from the top's edges), fused with the top.

transcript.user_prompt: Add four square legs, each 60 x 60 mm in cross-section, running from the floor at Z=0 up to the tabletop's underside at Z=720. Center them at X=+/-690 and Y=+/-340 so their outer faces sit 80 mm in from the tabletop edges, and fuse them with the top.
transcript.assistant_message: I added the four 60 mm square legs at X=+/-690, Y=+/-340, rising 720 mm from the floor to meet the tabletop's underside - each outer face is inset 80 mm from the top's edge.

steps.instruction: Add four aprons 20 mm thick and 100 mm tall, flush under the top (Z=620 to 720), spanning between the legs on their centerlines: two along X at Y=+/-340, 1320 mm long, and two along Y at X=+/-690, 620 mm long.

transcript.user_prompt: Connect the legs with four aprons, each 20 mm thick and 100 mm tall, tucked flush under the tabletop so they span Z=620 to Z=720. Run two long aprons along X at Y=+/-340, 1320 mm long between the legs' inner faces, and two short aprons along Y at X=+/-690, 620 mm long, all centered on the leg centerlines.
transcript.assistant_message: The apron frame is in: two 1320 mm rails along the length and two 620 mm rails across the width, 20 x 100 mm each, flush against the tabletop's underside between the legs.

steps.instruction: Fillet the tabletop's four vertical corner edges with a 20 mm radius.

transcript.user_prompt: Soften the tabletop: fillet its four vertical corner edges with a 20 mm radius.
transcript.assistant_message: I rounded the tabletop's four corners with a 20 mm fillet - the top now has soft corners while the legs and aprons stay crisp.
